definitions.explanation: A device that detects danger such as fire or smoke and sounds an alarm. Most often refers to a fire alarm or smoke detector.

examples.japanese: {火災|かさい}{報知器|ほうちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
{報知器|ほうちき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I replace the battery in the alarm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火災|かさい}{報知器|ほうちき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{義務付|ぎむづ}けられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: By law, homes are required to have fire alarms installed.

notes:
Compound of {報知|ほうち} (notification, reporting) + {器|き} (device). Almost always appears in the compound {火災|かさい}{報知器|ほうちき} (fire alarm).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火災|かさい}{報知器|ほうちき}: fire alarm
- {報知器|ほうちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: the alarm sounds
- {報知器|ほうちき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install an alarm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: warning, alert — the alert itself, not the device
- {感知器|かんちき}: sensor, detector — emphasizes detection rather than sounding an alarm
